description: This file defines an Android Activity called SplitTouchView, demonstrating splitting touch events across multiple ListView components within a layout. It sets up two ListViews, attaches adapters to display cheese names, and handles item click events to show toast messages with responses.

classes.name: SplitTouchView
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates touch event splitting between two ListView components.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures two ListViews with adapters and click listeners.

methods.name: itemClickListener
methods.description: Handles ListView item click events, showing a Toast message with a cheese name and a response string.
